# Neha Pawar

Neha Pawar  is an Indian actress who predominantly appears in Bollywood films. She has also appeared in a Punjabi film. She is known for her films Paranthe Wali Gali (2014) and Thoda Lutf Thoda Ishq (2015). She is going to appear as main lead actress in the Punjabi movie Kirdar-E-Sardar. She played leading role in Asees.
